description: The actual Tseitin clause list of a shared propositional formula \(A\) is satisfiable if and only if \(A\) has a satisfying original valuation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.equisatisfiable.{u} {α : Type u}
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  (∃ w,
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.ListModels w
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.encoding A)) ↔
    ∃ v, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v A = true
